name: Prison Break In
summary: In Tarren Mill, Magus Wordeen Voidglare faces a crisis during his research. Months ago, four Forsaken fled the Undercity with artifacts stolen from a secure vault, and Sylvanas wants them back.

sections.title: Thieves of the Dark Lady
sections.body: Magus Wordeen Voidglare came to Tarren Mill to research, but now a crisis demands his attention. Four Forsaken turned from their brethren and stole from the Dark Lady. They broke into a secure vault and took four artifacts the apothecaries need for certain studies. Sylvanas wants them returned.

sections.title: The Internment Camp
sections.body: The thieves fled the Undercity for Dalaran, where its wizards placed them in quarantine at the Lordamere Internment Camp. You are sent to find the traitors, recover the artifacts and report to Voidglare in Tarren Mill. There are four: a Bloodstone Wedge, Marble, Shard and Oval. Dermot holds the wedge, Ricter the marble, Alina the shard and Kegan Darkmar the oval.

faq.answer: Magus Wordeen Voidglare came to Tarren Mill to research, but now faces a crisis over four artifacts stolen from the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What did the Forsaken thieves steal?
faq.answer: The Forsaken stole four artifacts from a secure vault, needed by the apothecaries for certain studies: a Bloodstone Wedge, Marble, Shard and Oval.

faq.q: Where are the thieves being held?
faq.answer: The Dalaran wizards are holding the thieves in quarantine at the Lordamere Internment Camp.
The four traitors are Dermot, who holds the Bloodstone Wedge; Ricter, who holds the Marble; Alina, who holds the Shard; and Kegan Darkmar, who holds the Oval.
